page_title: CLE 0-1 NAN | Clermont v Nantes 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90+5' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+4' PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Clermont.
90+4' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and signals a foul after Eray Comert (Nantes) brought his opponent down.
90+3' Eray Comert (Nantes) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
90+3' Total attempts – 16:7.
90+1' Nantes fail to score from a corner as Mory Diaw (Clermont) leaps to collect the ball.

90+1' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Mory Diaw has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
89' Clermont seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
88' Habib Keita (Clermont) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
87' A free kick has been awarded to Nantes.
83' Here comes a substitution. Aiman Maurer (Clermont) is brought on as a substitute for Elbasan Rashani.
82' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
80' Pierre Aristouy decides to make a substitution. Quentin Merlin will be replaced by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes).
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marcus Coco (Nantes) is coming onto the pitch as Florent Mollet cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) executes a nice mid-range free kick. His effort only flies inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day.
78' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
78' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) brings his opponent down. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
77' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Clermont quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Clermont.
76' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Remy Descamps to dive and make a save.
76' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
75' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Florent Mollet (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
73' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
72' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
70' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Maxime Gonalons as he is replaced by Habib Keita (Clermont).
68' One of the Nantes players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
68' 8:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
67' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Clermont was in an offside position.
66' Florent Mollet (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
66' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
65' Clermont have a free kick.
63' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
62' Here is a change. Mehdi Zeffane is going off and Pascal Gastien gives the last tactical orders to Jim Allevinah (Clermont).
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Yohan Magnin (Clermont) coming on for Johan Gastien.
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) for Grejohn Kyei.
60' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Thomas Leonard stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
58' Pierre Aristouy has decided to make a change. Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) replaces Marquinhos.
53' Neto Borges (Clermont) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.

48' 0 - 1 Florent Mollet slides a pass towards Moses Simon (Nantes) who unleashes a shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the middle of the net. The score is now 0:1.
47' Clermont will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Nantes are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A goal, which was scored by Muhammed Cham (Clermont), was disallowed due to offside.
42' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
41' A crossfield pass from Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates.
36' Pierre Aristouy is forced to make a change. Ignatius Ganago is unable to continue due to injury, Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) comes on.
34' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' What a miss! The corner finds Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
33' Nantes earn a corner.

32' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Nantes will have a corner.

30' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the roof of the net, but he can't get the power to direct it past Remy Descamps, who keeps it out.
29' It looks like Douglas Augusto (Nantes) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Leonard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
28' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
26' Neto Borges (Clermont) is penalised for holding. Thomas Leonard signals a set piece.
25' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
24' A cooling break is underway.
24' The game is interrupted now, Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' Clermont take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
22' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Clermont.
21' A long pass, executed by Johan Gastien (Clermont), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
19' Wonderful movement by Nantes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
16' Clermont have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
15' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Grejohn Kyei, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
13' A player from Clermont commits a rough challenge. Thomas Leonard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
10' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
8' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) commits a rough foul. Thomas Leonard stops the game and makes a call.
5' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) strikes from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
4' The cross into the penalty area from Moses Simon (Nantes) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.

4' Nantes slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
2' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mory Diaw.
2' Rough tackle by Andy Pelmard (Clermont). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Nantes will kick the game off.
Thomas Leonard will supervise the game today.
